Synopsis:
    New York Liberty forward Satou Sabally is ruled out for the rest of the 2026 WNBA regular season and playoffs due to a concussion — her second in under a year. Signed to a 2-year/$1.6M deal in April, she averaged 10.4 pts in 13 games. The Liberty (24-16), seeded 6th, resume play Sept. 18 vs. Minnesota Lynx.
